notes: Flagged unit 10 (s010-s012, לְמָעְלָה → 'upward') retained: the preposition, the adverb and the directive he are contiguous and one English word carries all three senses, so rules 30 and 32 fuse them, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme. No English word answers to the לְ or the he on its own.

s007/s017: the ASV's 'whether' is given to the article morpheme standing in that slot, which the translation read as an interrogative he. The competing reading applies rule 41's closing enumeration — 'whether' is neither a 'the', a relative, a supplied pronoun nor a determiner — leaving the article unrepresented and 'whether' added under rule 55. The accepted reading was kept because a morpheme stands exactly where the word is written and the contract disfavours marking English added while a morpheme in its place goes unrendered. The margin's 'Or, that goeth' was read and set aside under rule 38.
s004 בְּנֵי is unrepresented because the ASV compresses 'the sons of men' to 'man'; the Hebrew marginal gloss corroborates the compression but decides nothing (rule 38).
The two chains are rendered differently — anarthrous 'of man' and arthrous 'of the beast' — so rule 29's fronting applies only to the first, and in the second the construct takes a supplied 'the'.
